1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan sebagai Perintah Majlis
Sukan Negara Malaysia (Pindaan Jadual Kedua) 1988.

2. (1) Tertakluk kepada subperenggan (2), Perintah ini
hendaklah disifatkan sebagai telah mula berkuatkuasa pada 1hb
Januari 1988.

(2) Kaedah 16 hendaklah mula berkuatkuasa pada tarikh
selepas sahaja tersiarnya Perintah ini dalam Warta.

3. Jadual Kedua Akta Majlis Sukan Negara Malaysia 1971

Act 1971

NATIONAL SPORTS COUNCIL OF MALAYSIA
(AMENDMENT OF SECOND SCHEDULE) ORDER 1988

In exercise of the powers conferred by subsection (2) of section 7A
of the National Sports Council of Malaysia Act 1971, the Minister
makes the following order:

1. This Order may be cited as the National Sports Council of
Malaysia (Amendment of Second Schedule) Order 1988.

2. (1) Subject to sub-paragraph (2) this Order shall be deemed to
have come into force on the 1st January 1988.

(2) Rule 16 shall come into force on the date immediately
following the date of its publication in the Gazette.

3. The Second Schedule of the National Sports Council of
Malaysia Act 1971 is amended by substituting therefore the
following:

(2) The accounts of the Council shall be audited
annually by the Auditor General or his representative,
State Auditor or auditors appointed by the Council
with the approval of the Minister, Menteri Besar or
Chief Minister of the State.

(3) The accounts of the Council shall be audited
within six months of the end of each financial year and
within such period the Committee shall cause a copy of
the statement of accounts in such manner as the
Minister, Menteri Besar or Chief Minister of the State
may require to be transmitted to them, together with a
copy of any observation made by the State Auditor or
auditors appointed by the Committee.

15. The Council shall not later than the 30th day of
June of each year, cause to be made and transmitted to
Minister, Menteri Besar or Chief Minister, a report
dealing with the activities of the Council during the
preceding year and containing such information
relating to the proceedings and policy of the Council.

16. (1) Except for the purpose of this Act or of any
criminal proceedings under this Act, no member,
officer or servant of the Council shall disclose any
information with respect to any individual business,
which has been obtained by him in the course of his
duties and which is not published in persuance of this
Act.

(2) Any member knowingly contravening the
provisions of the above paragraph (1) shall be guilty of
an offence and shall on conviction be liable to a fine not
exceeding five thousand ringgit or to imprisonment for
a term not exceeding one year.

17. All members of the Council and any officer or
servant of the Council shall be deemed to be a public
servant within the meaning of the Penal Code.

18. Subject to the provisions of this Act the Council
